## Dashboard API
One webhook, one function, one round trip. Every statement inside
`dashboard_api()` is scoped by the salon's `api_key`, so salon A
physically cannot read or write salon B's rows - proved by the tests.

**Setup:** pick the same Postgres credential, activate, then paste the
**production** URL and the salon's `api_key` into salon-dashboard.html.

**Before real customers:** put this behind HTTPS (n8n Cloud already is),
and rotate `api_key` if it is ever pasted into a chat or a screenshot.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin is `*` so the dashboard can be opened from
any machine; the api_key is what actually guards the data.
